id: title:Gilbert09:mark the known bad chat list 400 as non retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion: Classifies Vapi chat endpoint 400 errors as non-retryable, preventing unnecessary retry loops for a known-bad endpoint.
review.reason: Adds a specific, bounded configuration entry to the warehouse ingestion error handling, distinguishing a known-bad Vapi chat 400 error from other 400s. This is a maintenance and reliability improvement for warehouse ingestion, not a broad systemic change.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based solely on the observed code changes; no independent verification of actual incident avoidance or adoption exists. The benefit is inferred from the implementation of a safeguard, not demonstrated by runtime behavior or historical data.

observations.limitations: This chunk adds a new Vapi chat endpoint to the warehouse source, including its non-retryable 400 error and a corresponding test assertion. No adoption, incident, or benefit is demonstrated. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable 400 error entry for the Vapi chat endpoint, alongside an updated test assertion and comment.
